description: Compliance rules for AI-generated cold outbound email.

deterministic_rules.description: Message must include a clear opt-out / unsubscribe mechanism.
No guarantees, risk-free claims, or manufactured-urgency phrases.
Message must identify the sender name and company.

judge_rules.description: Every claim about the prospect must be supported by the verified lead facts. Any unsupported claim is a fabrication.
Tone is professional, respectful, and not pushy or manipulative.
No unverifiable superlative claims about our product or results.
